reuse.why: Extends the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate, which every holiday check in the tree goes through, and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate for formatting.

duplication.why: The MM-DD match is added once in a small isHoliday helper; nothing is repeated.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing holiday predicate, and the format is documented on RecurConfig.holidays.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the type doc comment, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A minimal, commented change at the single choke point for holiday checks, so every caller picks up the new format.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers already go through isWeekendOrHoliday, which is where the change lands.
